about: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next EXL3 3.05bpw_h5_ng5 on one RTX 3090: experts in pinned RAM behind a GPU expert cache, n-gram table on NVMe (trellis-serve ft-vision 1e72b25, text + images)
setup: NEEDS: 1x RTX 3090 24 GB (the server takes the whole card: 21,562 MiB at ready, 24,026 MiB peak with a 4096x4096 image; the expert cache auto-sizes to free VRAM, so nothing else may use the GPU); 75 GB of free system RAM (measured system-wide MemAvailable drop at server ready; process peaks: scheduler 63.4 GB RSS + launcher 2.0 + detokenizer 1.7; page-locked: 45.8 GB routed experts + 8 GB n-gram row cache + 1.18 GB token embedding); 85.14 GB for the weights on a LOCAL NVMe SSD (52.3 GB of shards read once at load; the 32.6 GB n-gram table is random-read with O_DIRECT while serving, so no network or tmpfs filesystem). Text and images (256x256 to 4096x4096 tested; EXL3 ViT decoded to bf16 at load, CPU preprocessing, SDPA ViT attention, ViT MLP chunk 8192). Launch = trellis-serve cuda/scripts/serve_flashnext_3090.sh at 1e72b25 plus --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder (not in the measured runs), on a bridge network with --shm-size 64g where the measured runs used --ipc=host --ulimit memlock=-1. First start JIT-compiles the n-gram NVMe extension (~1 min). Protocol sweep VIS010 (omarchy, PCIe 4.0 x16, 26.2 GB/s host-to-device): prefill 8k 2,627.5 / 16k 2,785.0 / 32k 2,846.0 / 64k 2,824.3 tok/s; decode aggregate C1 62.70 / C2 77.44 / C3 84.76 / C4 79.31 tok/s, C1 at 32k context 62.50. Quality vs stock exllamav3: text panel top-1 0.99067 / KL 0.000956; vision gate top-1 0.9729 / KL 0.00825, 8/8 answers correct. Context 204,800, KV pool 209,984 tokens fp8. A rented 3090 with 14-16 GB/s host-to-device decoded 53.2 tok/s (V001b): PCIe bandwidth matters. SGLANG_EXL3_NGRAM_TIER=pinned keeps the n-gram table in RAM instead (+24.6 GB RAM, no NVMe needed).
